title: Place workloads by lane: Google Cloud plus IBM Quantum
statement: Workloads are placed by time lane (reflex, warm, slow/training, ledger, fabric, quantum) rather than one runtime everywhere; application/data/compute run on Google Cloud and QPU workloads on IBM Quantum.
rationale: One runtime everywhere puts global services on the local hot path.

verification.check: Terraform and the image matrix place reflex, warm and quantum workloads on distinct runtimes; a module that put the edge node on Cloud Run would fail.

notes: IBM Quantum is reached via Qiskit Runtime per ADR 0006.

title: Reflex cells run on dedicated C3/C3D-class low-latency VMs
statement: Regional Reflex Cells run as Rust binaries on dedicated GCE C3/C3D-class (or equivalent) low-latency VMs.
rationale: Shared or serverless runtimes add jitter the reflex lane cannot absorb.

verification.check: terraform plan for an environment with one execution node renders a c3-class instance running qip-edge-node; a non-C3 machine_type is refused.

title: CPU pinning, huge pages, mlock, busy polling as justified
statement: Reflex nodes apply CPU pinning, huge pages, mlock and busy polling where measurement justifies them.
rationale: Hot-path threads sharing cores with the OS miss latency budgets.

verification.check: Node boot refuses without isolcpus/huge pages; process is pinned and memory-locked; removing isolcpus check lets an unpinned node boot.

title: Reflex cells hold direct venue connectivity
statement: Reflex cells connect directly to venues (no central hop between cell and venue).
rationale: A central hop adds latency and a shared failure point.

verification.check: qip-edge-node sends to a venue gateway from the node itself; removing the local gateway leaves no send path.

notes: Paper-trading only (ADR 0003): only simulated/sandbox venues are admissible.

title: Stateless burst warm services run on Cloud Run
statement: Warm services that are stateless and burst-shaped run on Cloud Run where serverless economics are beneficial.
rationale: Paying for idle capacity for bursty stateless services.

verification.check: terraform plan renders google_cloud_run_v2_service for the catalogue workloads.

title: Stateful long-running warm services run on GKE
statement: Stateful/long-running platform services run on GKE.
rationale: Mis-placing stateful services on serverless runtimes.

verification.check: terraform plan renders a GKE cluster hosting the stateful services.

notes: Conflicts with ADR 0024 (Cloud Run + one Compute Engine node per region, no Kubernetes).

title: Training/AGI runs on Google Cloud GPU/TPU compute
statement: Training and AGI workloads run on GPU/TPU compute on Google Cloud using fit-for-purpose tooling (Python/JAX/PyTorch or other).
rationale: Training on CPU-only serving hosts starves serving and is uneconomic.

verification.check: Terraform provisions an accelerator training pool; a plan without accelerators fails the check.

notes: Python tooling conflicts with ADR 0001/0011 (Rust everywhere) unless an ADR admits it.

title: Trained artifacts export to bounded inference runtimes
statement: Training outputs are exported as artifacts into bounded inference runtimes rather than served from the training stack.
rationale: Unbounded models on serving paths break latency and memory budgets.

verification.check: A distilled artifact carries memory/latency/worst-case bounds and is refused by the reflex lane if out of bounds.

title: Global ledger on strongly consistent multi-region transactional store
statement: The global ledger is held in Cloud Spanner or an equivalent strongly consistent multi-region transactional store.
rationale: A ledger without strong consistency can double-count capital across regions.

verification.check: Plan renders the store and the ledger daemon writes through it; disabling it makes ledger commit refuse.

title: Append-only object/event archive holds immutable evidence
statement: Beside the ledger store, an append-only object/event archive holds immutable evidence.
rationale: Evidence that can be rewritten cannot support audit.

verification.check: Archive objects are write-once (retention lock/hash chain); an overwrite attempt is refused.

title: Fabric runs on dedicated regional GCE nodes across three zones
statement: The Algorik Rust Event & Control Fabric runs on dedicated regional GCE broker/controller nodes spread across three zones.
rationale: A single-zone fabric loses control plane on a zone outage.

verification.check: Plan renders broker/controller instances in three zones per region.

title: No Pub/Sub or Kafka on the internal core path
statement: Internal services use the native fabric protocol; Google Pub/Sub and Kafka do not appear on the internal core path, and optional compatibility bridges are edge adapters only.
rationale: A generic broker dictates control semantics, replay and regional independence.

verification.check: Manifest scan refuses any Kafka/PubSub client outside an edge bridge crate.

notes: Also stated as a §31 COMPLETE TARGET.

title: Cloud Storage holds artifacts, manifests, packages, simulation outputs
statement: Cloud Storage holds temporary/retained artifacts, manifests, model packages, simulation outputs and reproducible campaign datasets.
rationale: Artifacts scattered over local disks are not reproducible.

verification.check: Buckets exist for each named artifact class with retention set.

title: Keys in Cloud KMS/HSM with segregated custody/signing
statement: Secrets and keys are held in Cloud KMS/HSM plus segregated custody/signing systems.
rationale: Keys in application hosts can be exfiltrated with the host.

verification.check: Plan renders KMS keys; signing keys are not readable by workloads that do not sign.

title: No browser access to keys, ledger internals or execution nodes
statement: The browser has no access to keys, ledger internals or execution nodes.
rationale: A browser path to keys or nodes turns an XSS into a trading incident.

verification.check: Acceptance scan finds no frontend route or API surface exposing key material, ledger internals or node endpoints.

title: Isolated Quantum Gateway with queue-aware async jobs and fallback
statement: IBM Quantum is reached only through an isolated Quantum Gateway/Foundry with queue-aware asynchronous job orchestration and a classical fallback.
rationale: Synchronous QPU calls make execution depend on a queue nobody controls.

verification.check: A synchronous job is refused; a queued job that times out yields the classical answer.

title: OpenTelemetry plus OpenObserve-compatible observability stack
statement: Observability uses OpenTelemetry with OpenObserve or a compatible stack.
rationale: Proprietary/no telemetry makes the platform unoperable.

verification.check: Processes export OTel traces/metrics and an OpenObserve instance ingests them.

notes: An OTel SDK crate would breach ADR 0002/0009; in-tree exposition is the current approach.

title: Trace each opportunity end to end across all stages
statement: Each end-to-end opportunity is traceable across brain, model, risk, node, venue, ledger and learning loop under one trace.
rationale: Without one trace a decision cannot be attributed after the fact.

verification.check: A cycle produces one trace id visible in brain, risk, node, venue, ledger and learning records.

title: Tick archive in object storage with partitioning, manifests, entitlements
statement: Tick and internal execution history are archived in Cloud Storage/object storage with compressed partitioning, manifests and entitlements.
rationale: Unmanifested history cannot be replayed reproducibly or licensed.

verification.check: Archived partitions carry a manifest and entitlement; a partition without one is refused at read.

title: Replay workers on dedicated compute with local caches/indexes
statement: Replay workers use dedicated compute and local high-throughput caches/indexes.
rationale: Replay contending with serving compute.

verification.check: A replay worker pool is provisioned separately from serving.

title: External world content refetched, never retained as raw corpus
statement: External world source content is re-fetched from its origin/provider when needed and is never retained as a raw corpus.
rationale: A raw corpus breaches licences and becomes an uncontrolled store.

verification.check: No store persists raw external documents; retention keeps only derived records and refetch pointers.

title: Microstructure outputs packaged through Model Registry
statement: Microstructure training outputs are packaged through the Model Registry into warm/reflex-compatible artifacts.
rationale: Unregistered artifacts reach the reflex lane without evaluation.

verification.check: A trained microstructure model reaches the edge only as a registry-signed ModelPack.

title: No single world model on the reflex critical path
statement: World-model services are long-running and versioned with domain-specific stores, and no single model sits on the reflex critical path.
rationale: A model outage would stop trading.

verification.check: Reflex node compile set excludes world-model crates.

title: Symbolic reasoning in warm/slow pools; bounded predicates compiled to reflex
statement: Graph/logic/constraint/planning runtimes run in warm/slow pools; deterministic solvers may compile bounded predicates into reflex artifacts.
rationale: Unbounded reasoning on the hot path.

verification.check: Reasoning crates are excluded from the reflex compile set; compiled predicates carry bounds.

title: Ambient mesh scheduled continuously with wakeups and surprise scoring
statement: Ambient model services are continuously scheduled/streaming with event-driven wakeups, stateful forecasts, surprise scoring and attention routing.
rationale: Cognition that only answers prompts misses unprompted signals.

verification.check: A scheduled ambient service emits AmbientSignals that the attention router turns into AttentionEvents.

title: Isolated budgets stop background cognition starving trading
statement: Ambient cognition runs under isolated resource budgets so it cannot starve trading paths.
rationale: Background cognition starving reflex/risk/ledger.

verification.check: Ambient crates are absent from order-path crates and attention spend is budget-capped.

title: Action orchestrator with typed adapters, identity and durable journal
statement: The Causal Agency/Action Orchestrator runs as slow/warm services with typed tool adapters, a policy/identity service, causal simulation access and a durable action journal.
rationale: Untyped adapters and no journal make actions unauditable.

verification.check: An action passes through a typed adapter after policy/identity checks and is journaled durably.

title: Public/channel adapters use segregated credentials and conduct policy
statement: Public/channel adapters use segregated credentials and are subject to disclosure/conduct policy.
rationale: Shared credentials let one compromised channel act as another.

verification.check: Each channel adapter is registered with its own identity; the conduct gate blocks a non-compliant communication.

title: No direct path from ambient model to external action
statement: No path exists from an ambient model to an external action without passing the agency/authority/conduct gates.
rationale: Detection triggering action directly bypasses authorization.

verification.check: Ambient types cannot reach an action adapter; advisory unwrap requires promotion.

notes: Also a §31 COMPLETE TARGET.

title: Effect attribution service with controls, multi-horizon, uncertainty
statement: Effect Attribution/Experiment Service supports experiment assignment where permissible, synthetic/no-action controls, multi-horizon metrics and uncertainty-aware EffectAttribution outputs.
rationale: Attributing effects without controls confuses correlation with causation.

verification.check: Attribution without a control/counterfactual method or confidence is refused.

title: Fabric is not the execution hot path
statement: Local market-event-to-order decisions and direct peer Reflex Mesh coordination do not depend on the fabric.
rationale: A broker outage would stop execution.

verification.check: Reflex decision thread never calls a blocking fabric API; edge crates do not depend on the broker crate.

title: fabricd brokers hold append-only partition logs and subscriptions
statement: fabricd brokers provide append-only partition logs and subscriptions.
rationale: Without append-only logs replay is impossible.

verification.check: Produce then fetch returns records in append order with dense offsets; a subscriber receives later batches.

title: Consumer checkpoints and consumer groups
statement: Brokers maintain consumer checkpoints (committed offsets) and consumer groups.
rationale: Consumers cannot resume after failure without committed offsets.

verification.check: A consumer commits an offset, restarts, and resumes from it; two group members split partitions.

title: Brokers enforce per-stream retention
statement: Brokers apply each stream's retention policy.
rationale: Unbounded retention violates bounded-retention rules.

verification.check: Segments older than the stream's retention are removed after archival.

title: Partition leaders/followers with replication
statement: Brokers act as regional partition leaders/followers and replicate partition logs.
rationale: A single disk loses records on host loss.

verification.check: A follower holds an identical log; killing the leader loses no committed record.

title: Brokers apply backpressure
statement: Brokers apply backpressure to producers that exceed quotas or lag limits.
rationale: An overloaded broker otherwise drops or stalls everything.

verification.check: A producer over quota is refused/slowed and the refusal is visible.

title: fabric-controller three-zone Raft metadata quorum
statement: A fabric-controller runs a three-zone metadata quorum (Rust Raft) for stream definitions, partition placement, broker epochs, ACL metadata and leadership, with no cloud database required for regional operation.
rationale: Metadata on one node or in a cloud DB makes regional operation depend on it.

verification.check: Losing one of three controller nodes keeps metadata writable; losing two halts control changes only.

title: fabric-mirror selective async cross-region replication
statement: fabric-mirror replicates selected streams asynchronously cross-region with no global write quorum; each region stays independently writable.
rationale: A global quorum lets a remote outage stop local operation.

verification.check: Mirror copies selected streams; local writes succeed while the mirror is down.

title: fabric-schema: versioned descriptors, compatibility checks, schema hashes
statement: fabric-schema maintains versioned contract descriptors, compatibility checks, schema hashes and generated Rust types.
rationale: Incompatible producers silently corrupt consumers.

verification.check: Removing/renaming a field without a version bump is refused; identical content yields identical schema id.

notes: Text says Protobuf descriptors; Protobuf/prost needs an ADR (ADR 0002/0009).

title: fabric-archive exports sealed segments to Cloud Storage
statement: Sealed segments are exported to Cloud Storage/Tick Lake with manifests, hashes, entitlements and replay indexes.
rationale: Unarchived segments are lost when retention expires.

verification.check: Every sealed segment of an archive-required stream lands once in the archive with manifest and hash.

title: fabric-bridge adapters are optional and edge-only
statement: External Kafka/Pub/Sub/webhook bridges are optional edge-only adapters; internal services use the native protocol.
rationale: A bridge on the core path reintroduces the generic broker.

verification.check: Only a bridge crate may hold a client, it holds no durable state, and nothing depends on it.

title: fabricctl operator CLI for health, lag, ACLs, mirroring, replay, isolation
statement: A Rust operator CLI reports stream/partition health, lag, ACLs, mirroring and replay and performs emergency isolation.
rationale: Operators without tooling cannot contain a bad stream.

verification.check: CLI isolates a partition and the broker refuses produce until release.

title: fabric-bench latency/throughput benchmark harness
statement: A latency/throughput benchmark harness exists for the fabric.
rationale: Unmeasured latency claims.

verification.check: A bench target reports produce/fetch latency percentiles.

title: fabric-chaos deterministic fault/partition testing in CI and game days
statement: Deterministic fault/partition testing of the fabric runs in CI and game days.
rationale: Failover paths never exercised fail when needed.

verification.check: A seeded fault test kills/partitions brokers and asserts no committed loss.

title: Rust SDK: idempotent sequencing, groups, async subscriptions, OTel hooks
statement: The Rust SDK offers zero-copy-friendly producer/consumer APIs, idempotent producer sequencing, consumer groups, async subscriptions, local ring-buffer integration and OpenTelemetry hooks.
rationale: Each service re-implementing producer logic gets sequencing wrong.

verification.check: SDK producer and served broker agree on sequences; duplicate producer sequence is deduplicated.

title: QUIC over UDP with mutual TLS for broker, client and mirror traffic
statement: Broker/client and cross-region mirror traffic uses QUIC over UDP with mutual TLS, with long-lived streams for durable records.
rationale: Plaintext or unauthenticated transport lets any host inject records.

verification.check: A client without a valid certificate cannot connect; traffic is QUIC.

notes: In-tree TLS/QUIC is prohibited by ADR 0009; a QUIC/TLS crate needs a new ADR.

title: QUIC datagrams only for explicitly lossy telemetry classes
statement: Unreliable datagrams are used only for streams explicitly declared lossy telemetry.
rationale: Lossy delivery for durable records loses money facts.

verification.check: A durable class configured for datagram delivery is refused.

title: Wire format is versioned Protobuf via prost
statement: Contracts are encoded on the wire as versioned Protobuf via prost for compatibility.
rationale: Ad-hoc formats break cross-version compatibility.

verification.check: Encoded records decode with prost against the registered descriptor.

title: Records and segments carry BLAKE3/content hashes and CRC
statement: Every record/segment carries a content hash (BLAKE3) and CRC protection.
rationale: Silent corruption reaches consumers.

verification.check: A flipped bit is refused as corruption naming its offset.

title: No unversioned in-memory layouts on the network
statement: Hot in-process data structures may use zero-copy layouts but never leak unversioned memory formats onto the network.
rationale: Unversioned layouts break across binary versions.

verification.check: Every encoded batch carries magic/version; a wrong version is refused.

title: Strict per-partition order; no global total order promised
statement: Ordering is strict within a partition and no total global order is promised.
rationale: Consumers relying on a false global order misreplay.

verification.check: Random produce/fetch/restart keeps offsets dense and fetches in append order.

title: Every record carries times, region, partition, epoch, offset, HLC
statement: Every record carries source event time, receive time, region, partition, leader epoch, offset and hybrid logical clock metadata.
rationale: Records without placement/time metadata cannot be replayed or ordered.

verification.check: An envelope missing any of these fields is refused.

title: At-least-once default; at-most-once only telemetry; effectively-once via idempotency
statement: Durable streams default to at-least-once; at-most-once is allowed only for telemetry; idempotent producer ids/sequence numbers and deterministic event ids give effectively-once with idempotent sinks.
rationale: Duplicate or lost financial outcomes.

verification.check: A durable stream with an at-most-once profile is refused; a replayed producer sequence is not appended twice.

title: Durability classes: control quorum+WAL, outcomes quorum+archive, journals, telemetry
statement: Control streams use three-zone quorum plus persistent metadata/WAL; financial outcomes use quorum replication and archival; market journals use high-throughput replicated segments; telemetry can be sampled/dropped.
rationale: One durability level for all is either unsafe or too slow.

verification.check: Each class's declared ack/replication is what the broker enforces.

title: Every stream has byte/message quotas, lag limits and overload policy
statement: Every stream declares explicit byte/message quotas, lag limits and an overload policy.
rationale: Unspecified broker defaults decide overload.

verification.check: A stream missing a quota, lag limit or overload policy is refused.

title: Critical control/outcomes never silently dropped; telemetry may be shed
statement: Critical control and outcome records cannot be silently dropped; telemetry and low-value ambient signals may be sampled or shed.
rationale: A silently shed outcome is an accounting hole.

verification.check: Under overload, P0/P1 producers are refused (visible) not dropped; a recorded-inputs overflow writes a gap on P1.

title: Cross-region mirroring is async; regional cluster never blocks on remote ack
statement: Selected streams mirror asynchronously over Google private networking and a regional cluster never blocks on remote acknowledgement.
rationale: A remote outage would stop local execution or control.

verification.check: Cutting the inter-region link does not block local produce.

title: Reflex node publishes via non-blocking local ring/journal writer on a separate core
statement: The Reflex Node publishes through a non-blocking local ring/journal writer running on a separate core.
rationale: A blocking publish stalls the decision thread.

verification.check: Decision thread hands off with try_send; a stalled writer leaves entries unshipped without blocking.

title: Book, inference, risk veto and venue send never wait on broker ack

rationale: Execution latency becomes broker latency.

verification.check: No edge crate depends on qip-streaming/transport broker client in the pass.

title: Packages are signed immutable artifacts; fabric carries only digests/activation

rationale: Shipping weights over the fabric bloats it and bypasses signing.

verification.check: A model manifest carries only digests and is size-bounded; unknown fields refused.

title: Fabric outage: node continues on last valid package until TTL/risk degradation

rationale: Halting on fabric loss makes the fabric a hot-path dependency.

verification.check: With no new payload, the cell keeps trading at narrowing size and refuses after valid_for elapses.
